_comment: EXAMPLE candidate policy for `python -m failsafe.replay --policy examples/policy_whatif_retry_low_balance.json`. A merchant proposes (1) retrying low-balance cards immediately instead of waiting for payday and (2) giving up on generic card_declined instead of sending a payment link. Replay shows exactly which recorded decisions this would change before it ships. Not used by the live pipeline.

_action_glossary.immediate_retry: Usually a temporary glitch (network blip, bank downtime) - the system automatically retries the same charge right away. No customer contact needed.
_action_glossary.delayed_retry: Usually a customer-side issue that tends to clear on its own with time (e.g. low balance before payday) - the system waits, then retries automatically later. No customer contact needed.
_action_glossary.payment_link_nudge: Cannot be safely auto-retried - the customer needs to take an action themselves (e.g. enter a new card). The system sends them a secure payment link to fix it on their own.
_action_glossary.no_action_fraud: The bank flagged this as suspected fraud. The system takes no automated action at all and hands it to a human to review - auto-retrying a fraud flag would be the wrong call, not just a wasted attempt.
_action_glossary.no_action_unrecoverable: The customer cancelled, or the card is blocked/dead. Nothing left to try automatically - the case is closed instead of retried forever.

_note_simulated_success_rate: simulated_success_rate is used ONLY by generate_data.py to fabricate realistic-looking outcomes for this project's synthetic test data. It has no effect on the real gate decision or any real Razorpay call - editing it will not change how the system behaves for a real subscription.

insufficient_funds.description: The customer's bank account did not have enough funds

card_expired.description: Customer's card has passed its expiration date

card_not_enrolled.description: Card lacks activation for digital transactions

card_disabled_for_online_payments.description: Card not enabled for online transaction use

incorrect_cvv.description: The customer entered an incorrect CVV

authentication_failed.description: Incorrect OTP entry or browser closure during verification

debit_instrument_blocked.description: Card blocked by customer or bank

debit_instrument_inactive.description: Card not activated for online use

transaction_limit_exceeded.description: The customer has already reached the maximum transaction limit for the day

payment_timed_out.description: The payment could not be completed as the customer exceeded the time limit

gateway_technical_error.description: Partner bank downtime prevented payment processing

card_declined.description: The payment was declined by the customer's bank

payment_risk_check_failed.description: The customer's bank declined the payment, citing it as fraudulent

payment_cancelled.description: Customer terminated the transaction or navigated away during processing

payment_failed.description: The payment was declined by the customer's bank
